description: A bigger machine (more CPU and memory): no code changes, but a hard ceiling and still a single point of failure.
More machines of the same size behind a load balancer; needs a stateless tier but has no hard ceiling.
A copy of the database fed by the primary; it serves reads and may lag slightly behind the latest write.
A worldwide network of cache servers that delivers static files from an edge server near the user.
DNS that answers each user with the address of the nearest healthy data center.
A durable buffer between a producer that enqueues jobs and workers that process them later, so slow work leaves the request path.
Splitting data across several databases by a key; it scales writes but makes cross-shard queries and rebalancing hard.
